title.zh: 自己的音色改成存在设备上，所有项目都能用
title.en: Your saved sounds now live on the device, available to every project

highlights.zh: 自建预置不再绑在单个项目上：存一次，这台设备上的每个项目都能看到；导出为 gs1.1.… 分享码即可带到别的设备或给别人。
highlights.en: Saved presets are no longer tied to one project: save once and every project on this device sees it; export it as a gs1.1.… share code to move it to another device or person.

highlights.zh: 浏览器存在 IndexedDB（库版本升到 3，老库原地升级、记录不动）；MCP 存在 ~/.groove/user-presets.json，采用「先写临时文件再改名」避免崩溃时写坏整库。
highlights.en: The browser keeps them in IndexedDB (library version 3, older databases upgraded in place with their records untouched); the MCP keeps them in ~/.groove/user-presets.json, written via a temp file and rename so a crash cannot corrupt the whole library.
